sloka: यत्तु कार्यं वयस्येन सुहृदा वा परन्तप ।कृतं सुग्रीव तत् सर्वं भवता ऽधर्म भीरुणा ।। ६.१२५.१६ ।।
transliteration: yattu kāryaṁ vayasyena suhṛdā vā parantapa ।kṛtaṁ sugrīva tat sarvaṁ bhavatā 'dharma bhīruṇā ।। 6.125.16 ।।

translations.english: "Vibheeshana, I would like to see you living like Indra bestowed with your own kingdom in Lanka. It will not be possible for even gods to attack you."
